articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CompX International Inc. (NYSE American: CIX) announced today that, subject to the completion of quarter-end closing procedures, it expects to report third quarter 2026 earnings in a press release after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. ...
articles.title: COMPX ANNOUNCES EXPECTED THIRD QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE DATE
